title: A simple extension generated by a separable element is separable
statement: Let $E/F$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] and let $\alpha\in E$ be separable algebraic over $F$, meaning that its minimal polynomial over $F$ is separable [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Let $F(\alpha)\subseteq E$ denote the smallest subfield containing the image of $F$ and $\alpha$ (the intersection of all such subfields). Then $F(\alpha)/F$ is a separable algebraic extension [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension].
